f1_planning_handoff: Carry the approved parent reservation contract into concrete feature schemas, entry points and Task acceptance: one tracking-trunk executions sidecar and lifecycle lock, stable original-incident identity, atomic reservation, exactly-once settlement and independent bounded extension. Split product/tracking roots must not create a second spendable ledger.

Specify F2's consumer interface before dispatch: incident, claim and operation identities, reservation and settlement receipts, version compatibility, named refusals and crash reconciliation. Preserve one top-level claim while charging serialized nested tool operations; a competing caller remains pending. Retain the parent-required real provider-to-MCP-to-validator acceptance path across F1/F2.

Keep the first vertical proof in F1: a real timeout, process-group cleanup, restart suppression of unchanged failure, authorized material correction or extension, one useful next publication and independent remote verification. Preserve old attempts and resolved decisions; unknown lineage or consumption fails closed.

Use the approved numerical policy by reference. Material generations, replacement action IDs, policy cycles and wakeups never renew incident allowance. Do not weaken validation to fit a budget or grant extensions to the retrying team.

Keep complete provider launch enforcement and capability/usage evidence in F2, loaded-runtime/bootstrap proof in F3, and broad adversarial CI plus controlled operational proof in F4. F1 must leave an implementable shared interface without claiming those later obligations complete.

Propagate applicable diagram-impact rows into Tasks, including the Task budget owner, Watchdog consumers and Teams publication Code declarations. Reconcile actual source symbols, declaration kinds, contract/model/design links, normal and failure/restart flows, browser navigation and bounds against the delivered diff.
Use propose_epic_amendment for any needed parent contract, ownership, policy or sequencing change. Do not silently change the approved parent or another team's worktree.
